Credit rules (planned)

Subscription credits accumulate while the subscription remains active and do not expire month-to-month. Purchased top-up credits do not expire. If a subscription is cancelled, unused subscription credits are lost at the end of the paid period; purchased credits remain. Access continues until the paid period ends. A pause, as discussed, would continue monthly billing and credit grants. Final proration and account rules require backend/payment implementation.
